summary: legal checked in 6 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Legal disposition: blocked for public beta or full launch; keep searchwoot.com private. Woot API access is evidenced, but public terms do not establish rights to store, derive, display, cache, alert on, or monetize returned data. All four data-use items remain evidence_needed: source rights, alert-data retention and user workflows, GA4 consent/configuration, and operational log/vendor handling. Human counsel is required for upstream rights, privacy/jurisdiction, and any affiliate or advertising use. The next evidence actions are to attach a written-permission request draft, produce the repository/configuration data-flow and retention table, capture deployed consent behavior and GA4 settings, and inventory logs/vendors and incident procedures. Do not close launch-readiness tasks without those artifacts and the non-legal gates.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active. No task is closed because the current evidence only confirms partial data-flow and consent artifacts; it does not establish retention, deletion, correction, access, vendor, incident, or rights controls. Next evidence action: attach the authoritative Woot permission or terms record and record permitted fields, caching, display, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, and takedown rules.

Data-use review: Woot API deal and price-history data is blocked. Missing evidence: written redistribution/commercial permission, field-level provenance, stale-data behavior, and correction/takedown process. Smallest next action: prepare and attach a draft request for SearchWoot-specific permission; do not send it or expose data.

Data-use review: user alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed. Missing evidence: data inventory, retention, deletion/correction workflow, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce a read-only data-flow and retention table from the repository and deployed configuration.

Data-use review: GA4 analytics is evidence_needed. Missing evidence: deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property and data-sharing settings, retention settings, vendor disclosure, and jurisdiction-specific review. Smallest next action: capture current consent and GA4 configuration without enabling tracking or advertising.

Data-use review: operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data is evidence_needed. Missing evidence: log-field inventory, retention and access controls, vendor terms or DPA review, and incident and data-request procedures. Smallest next action: produce a read-only operator and vendor inventory and identify counsel-required gaps.
